summary:
Research handoff recording the second confirmed in-scope violation and correcting a stale Surface reason; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Second finding confirmed: direct check a7ab7f884023425182fec9595c00ba14 executed its fixed bytes as 1987811182294bfbb372a36548be8d8b with prerequisites matched, comparison_complete and witness_complete true, and outcome violated. One declared out-of-window pure heartbeat (request header protocol version 0, node at ProtocolVersionMax) was rejected with ErrUnsupportedProtocol and changed nothing on the normal path (processRPC -> checkRPCHeader), while the heartbeat fast path (processHeartbeat -> appendEntries) advanced the persisted term from 0 to 5, adopted the sender as known leader, refreshed last contact and reported guard_applied false; the in-window control was accepted on the normal path, so the difference is attributable to the RPC-header window, not the request shape. The blocking review issue (processHeartbeat's main-thread comment vs the transport's connection-goroutine invocation) was resolved as an independent scope boundary rather than by weakening the claim.

Product contents: the draft map (base version 6) records the observed conditional relationship on b-heartbeat-fast-path and narrows its unknown to reachability and intent, and corrects the sendLatestSnapshot Surface whose stated reason no longer matched what has been read (replication.go:299-386 is now read; what remains unread is the snapshot store ordering/persistence guarantee and follower-side stream handling). Feedback carries the reference set and the remaining discriminators. Impact is clarification only — no meaning, identity, edge, requirement or Surface disposition changed, so both confirmed findings and all accepted results keep their original basis.

Explicitly preserved as open: whether an out-of-window peer can deliver a pure heartbeat in a legal deployment, whether the absent guard is deliberate design (which would make the correct disposition a documented assumption rather than a violation), the unmeasured election consequence of refreshing last contact, and the independent concurrency question about processHeartbeat (no obligation formed). Run state: map accepted at version 6 with two confirmed in-scope findings and no pending review work.
